digest.component_or_area: tracker initialization and environment identity management
propositions: Re-cloning a tracker without carrying git-ignored local state (.env-id, .opcert-key, .opcert-key.pub) causes a new environment identity to be silently minted, orphaning all attestations signed by the prior environment.
Events in the store carry env_id at the top level and discoverable on disk, but the init ensure unit and gen_local_files do not check for prior environment identities before minting a fresh uuid.

Minting into a populated store must emit a loud stderr warning naming prior env id(s), the attestation consequence, the git-ignored files to carry over, and the override mechanism, but still complete to support legitimate multi-clone workflows.
REBAR_ALLOW_ENV_REIDENTIFY=1 environment variable acknowledges re-identification and quietens the warning to a one-line note.

fsck must emit a counted ENV_ID_MISMATCH issue when the current environment's author(s) also wrote events under a different env id, scoped by author to avoid false positives in healthy multi-clone topologies.
